newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Same Time in HK$17 mln share placement.
newsitem.headline: Same Time in HK$17 mln share placement.

text.p: Electronics group Same Time Holdings Ltd said shareholder Sum Tai Holdings Ltd would place 26 million shares, or a 10 percent stake, at HK$0.69 per share to third party investors before buying the same amount of new shares.
Sum Tai, owned by Same Time directors Yip Sum-yin and Yu Hung-min, will buy the new shares at a net placing price per share after expenses, the statement said.
Net proceeds of HK$17 million will be used for working capital, Same Time said.
The aggregate shareholding of Sum Tai and Maroc Ventures Inc, which is owned by Same Time director Maurice Yip, will be diluted to 58.92 percent following the deal from 64.82 percent.
